summary: Analysis of 14 days of telemetry data demonstrates excellent glycemic control with a Time in Range (70-180 mg/dL) of 99.7%, average glucose of 117.0 mg/dL, 0.0% hypoglycemia below 70 mg/dL, and low glucose variability (CV 12.9%). Current basal rates, target ranges, carb ratios, and ISF segments maintain stable glucose overnight and postprandially. AAPS SMB/UAM automation operates within safe, well-calibrated guardrails without masking underlying profile defects.
strengths: Outstanding Time in Range at 99.7% with 0.0% time below range (<70 mg/dL) over 14 days.
Very low glucose variability with a Coefficient of Variation (CV) of 12.9% and SD of 15.1 mg/dL.
Overnight glucose stability between 00:00 and 06:00 local time remains steadily near target (mean 102.3-106.0 mg/dL).
Postprandial glucose curves across all recurring meal windows return smoothly to baseline within 240-360 minutes without late postprandial hypoglycemia.
issues: Mild postprandial glucose excursions peaking up to 188 mg/dL following weekend brunch meals (10:00-12:00).

analysis_steps.findings: CGM coverage is 100.0% across 14 days (1,345 valid 15-minute entries with 0 gaps). Active profile and treatment records are complete.
Zero hypoglycemia (<70 mg/dL) observed. Extremely stable glucose control with 99.7% TIR and CV of 12.9%. Minimum glucose recorded was 70.0 mg/dL.
Scheduled basal segments (0.85-1.05 U/h) hold glucose steady in fasting windows. Overnight local hourly averages (00:00-06:00) range tightly between 102.3 and 107.5 mg/dL.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Unannounced fasting windows during afternoon hours.

analysis_steps.findings: Carbohydrate ratios (9-12 g/U) and ISF (40-48 mg/dL/U) with a 5.5 h DIA bring postprandial glucose back to baseline within 240 minutes across 24 therapy windows.
analysis_steps.evidence: therapy_response_windows mean 240-min glucose change is +0.8 mg/dL; 360-min change is -0.8 mg/dL.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Isolated correction boluses without concurrent carbs.

analysis_steps.findings: SMB and UAM operate cleanly with safe parameters (3 min interval, 45 min max SMB basal, 30 min max UAM basal), providing micro-corrections without over-delivery.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Specific SMB activation condition flags (e.g. smb_always_enabled) are explicit nulls in export.

analysis_steps.findings: Safety limits (max basal 2.4 U/h, max IOB 8.0 U) provide safe guardrails relative to max scheduled basal (1.05 U/h) and meal boluses.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Autosens activation state is null in raw export settings.

analysis_steps.findings: Declared prebolus and immediate bolus percentages effectively mitigate postprandial spikes while avoiding early hypoglycemia across weekday breakfast and dinner windows.
analysis_steps.evidence: 24 therapy windows show steady postprandial resolution; weekday breakfast peak average is ~162-167 mg/dL.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Exact time of food ingestion relative to bolus record timestamp.

analysis_steps.findings: Declared 20 g e-carbs over 120 min for mixed weekend brunch appropriately matches the extended absorption pattern observed (peaking around 120 min at 188 mg/dL before resolving).
analysis_steps.evidence: Weekend brunch response windows show +62 to +70 mg/dL change at 120 min, returning to baseline by 240-360 min.

analysis_steps.findings: All profile, automation, and meal strategy parameters are well-aligned. Current baseline basal rates, target ranges, CR, ISF, DIA, and SMB settings should be kept unchanged.
analysis_steps.evidence: Combined evidence from steps 1-8 shows 99.7% TIR, 0% hypo, stable overnight basal, and complete postprandial resolution.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Verification needed for raw AAPS export null fields (smb_activation conditions and autosens_enabled).

recommendations.title: Maintain Current Profile Basal and Therapy Settings
recommendations.description: Telemetry demonstrates exceptional control (99.7% TIR, 0.0% time below range, CV 12.9%). Scheduled basal rates and carb ratios effectively maintain glycemic stability overnight and postprandially.

suggested_change.rationale: All current parameters perform safely and effectively.

recommendations.title: Verify Specific AAPS SMB Activation and Autosens Export Flags
recommendations.description: Specific sub-flags for SMB activation conditions and Autosens state exported as null. Verify in AAPS user interface that settings match intended configurations.

suggested_change.rationale: Ensure UI settings match expected profile configurations.

profile_recommendation.recommendation: Keep all current active profile settings (basal rates, CR, ISF, target ranges, and DIA) unchanged.
profile_recommendation.rationale: Current profile achieves 99.7% Time in Range with zero hypoglycemia and stable overnight glucose curves (102-106 mg/dL average).
profile_recommendation.next_check: Re-evaluate CGM telemetry after 14-30 days or following any significant change in daily routine or meal composition.

parameter_decisions.rationale: Overnight glucose local averages remain flat and stable (103.1-106.0 mg/dL) with zero hypoglycemia.
Morning baseline glucose remains stable across fasting and post-meal recovery windows.
Afternoon glucose levels show consistent return to baseline following meal absorption.
Evening glucose levels are well-controlled through dinner and pre-bed hours.
Overnight carb ratio setting is appropriate and safe.
Weekday breakfast boluses (42 g carbs, 4.2 U) yield predictable peak and complete 240-min recovery.
Midday carb ratio accurately covers weekend brunch meals when combined with declared meal strategy.
Dinner meal boluses (54 g carbs, 5.5 U) resolve smoothly back to baseline.
Overnight sensitivity setting maintains stable loop behavior without over-correction.
Morning sensitivity setting supports safe SMB and correction bolus delivery.
Afternoon sensitivity setting prevents postprandial over-correction.
Evening sensitivity setting provides stable correction response.
Target range effectively guides overnight loop control.
Daytime target range supports tight glycemic control without inducing low glucose.
Late evening target range ensures safe transition into sleep hours.
A 5.5-hour DIA accurately models rapid-acting insulin decay and prevents premature insulin stacking.
Both SMB and UAM enabled state are actively supporting postprandial management effectively.
Specific activation condition flags are null in export; verify in AAPS UI that desired activation triggers are active.

parameter_decisions.current_value: smb_interval_minutes=3 min; max_smb_basal_minutes=45 min; max_uam_smb_basal_minutes=30 min
parameter_decisions.suggested_value: smb_interval_minutes=3 min; max_smb_basal_minutes=45 min; max_uam_smb_basal_minutes=30 min
parameter_decisions.rationale: SMB delivery timing and strength limits are well-calibrated and safe.

parameter_decisions.parameter: AAPS / max basal and max IOB limits
parameter_decisions.rationale: Max basal (2.4 U/h) and max IOB (8.0 U) provide sufficient headroom while protecting against excessive accumulation.
Autosens sub-flags are null in raw export; verify in AAPS UI that sensitivity algorithms are configured as intended.
Carb absorption parameters accurately reflect observed decay curves across all recorded meals.

meal_strategy_summary.suggestion: Maintain current meal management approach using 10-20 min preboluses with 60-70% immediate boluses, supported by active SMB/UAM automation and e-carbs for higher-fat meals.
meal_strategy_summary.rationale: The strategy yields excellent postprandial control with a 99.7% TIR and complete 240-minute glucose recovery without hypoglycemia.
meal_strategy_summary.next_observation: Log exact meal start times relative to bolus timestamps in Nightscout event notes to confirm prebolus interval precision.

exceptions.suggestion: Continue 10 min prebolus, 60% immediate bolus split, and 20 g e-carbs over 120 min (+15 min offset). Consider extending prebolus by 5 minutes if peak glucose (>180 mg/dL) needs reduction.
exceptions.rationale: Higher-fat, mixed meal composition produces a delayed 120-min peak (~188 mg/dL) that resolves safely by 240-360 min.

exceptions.suggestion: Retain 20 min prebolus with 70% immediate bolus without e-carbs.
exceptions.rationale: Rapid carb absorption is effectively matched by immediate bolus delivery, reaching a modest peak (~162 mg/dL) and returning cleanly to baseline.

implementation_steps: Review current profile parameters and AAPS settings with your diabetes care team.
Verify in the AndroidAPS user interface that SMB activation conditions and Autosens settings are active as intended.
Continue current meal strategy, logging exact meal timing to monitor postprandial peak dynamics.
education: A DIA of 5.5 hours prevents the automated system from overestimating remaining active insulin and causing late postprandial hypoglycemia.
E-carbs (extended carbs) in AAPS model delayed carbohydrate absorption from high-fat or high-protein meals without requiring a traditional pump extended bolus.
safety_notes: This analysis is decision-support content for review with your healthcare provider.
Make parameter changes one at a time and monitor blood glucose closely after any setting adjustment.
Do not alter safety limits or basal rates without consulting your diabetes care team.
